t: This is Fulham Broadway station, on the Wimbledon branch of the District line, between Parsons Green and West Brompton in fare zone 2. It's the nearest station to Stamford Bridge, the home of Chelsea Football Club. The station sits in a cutting that was once open to the sky until the shopping centre development covered it, and the line comes back out shortly before West Brompton. The actress Briony McRoberts, an English actress, died here in 2013.
